model.name: T-version-in-header: app header shows version string on all screens (small, undisturbing)
model.description: R19.94 fix (PRIORITY 2): the app HEADER MUST display the current version (e.g. 'v0.5.x · rawbin') on ALL screens — small, low-contrast, undisturbing so it never dominates the UI but is always visible (useful on bug-report screenshots + QA).
